kiln.why.why: the card is the pane itself, so its glass fill, sheen, rim, float shadow, panel corner and inset padding all map from the material and depth roles and every pane is the same object
a portrait behind a lens with the pane rim and a soft shadow under the large size; initials on the loud solid when there is no photo

a button is a small pane, a sheet lit at its top and shaded at its foot, with the pane rim, a glint under the pointer and a shadow that is blue under the accent; loud, accent and quiet roles, all full pills
a small round pane with Button material (gloss, rim, pointer glint) and a 44px hit area around the small size
a carved track holding the choices, the chosen tab the blue accent sheet resting in it (D-009 keeps the blue), with a 44px hit area on each tab
a label etched into the glass, so it cannot be mistaken for a button; uppercase micro type in the text colour
one ring for every component, 2px in the text colour and offset from the edge, with a halo of the opposite colour so focus shows on any backdrop
grid columns, gutters and spans read from the layout roles, so panes on a page share one set of edges at every breakpoint
container widths and margins cap how wide content grows, so reading lines and grids stay a comfortable size on large screens
stack gaps come from the named gap scale, so spacing inside a pane always stays smaller than the pane padding around it
a status written on the glass, a glyph shape per tone in its mark colour and the word in the text colour, with no fill
a small glass pane to press; chosen is pressed into a carved recess with a check, so chosen chips add no loud marks
a banner is a line written on the pane, so tone marks are glyph colours only, a hairline separates it from the content, and its spacing follows the pane

menu-bg.$description: opaque: a list over glass must not let the scene read through the options

kiln.why.why: the closed control is a quiet pill on glass; the open list is opaque because options must never be read off a moving scene, with a check for the chosen one
a carved channel filled with the one blue to the value and the switch bead as the thumb, on a 44px target row
the bar is the target: 56px holds the label and value inside it and clears the 44px touch size
held in the hand, so a full pill like every other control
label and value keep the field's inset from the curved ends
the empty part is the same carve as a field, so in light the bar reads as a recess in the white pane and the white fill stands out from it
the bar is a groove like a field: shade under its top lip and the field's 3:1 edge all round
the filled part is chosen glass, lighter than the well, lit from above
the chosen glass fades toward its foot, one light from above
the filled glass catches the light on its top edge
a thin bar in the loud solid (white in dark, ink in light) marks where the value ends, the one loud mark on the control
a 4px bar: a mark to read, while the whole control is the thing to grab
the marker stands about half the bar's height
the marker sits just inside the end of the fill so it never touches the curve
the filled channel is a lit value, so in dark it gives off a soft light; in light it does not
the marker says where the value is now, so in dark it glows a little; in light it does not
240px of travel at least, and the width never follows the value text, so nothing around it moves while dragging
a field is a dimmed well in the glass, a full pill because it is held, with the sunken page surface on reading pages
checkbox and radio are small recesses carved into the surface like the switch track, with a 44px hit area; checked shows a check and chosen shows a dot, never colour alone
the switch track is a well that turns the system blue when on, the one place a form uses its own colour, and a tick and the knob position say on
labels sit above their field and look like labels, help reads as secondary, and an error carries a glyph and a spoken word as well as colour
the upper lip of the groove, in shade
the lower lip of the groove, catching the light from above
each lip is one hairline, the thinnest recess the glass can show
an inset divider stops at the content inset, in line with the text
a vertical divider is at least as tall as an icon, so it still reads between two small items
the underline sits a little below the baseline so it never cuts through descenders
the underline at rest is a quiet line in the text colour, the only thing that marks a link since the system owns no hue
the groove and its arc are two pixels, readable at the small size
the groove the arc turns in, a quiet recess
the arc is the loud solid, white in dark and ink in light, the one thing moving on the pane
a skeleton is pressed into the glass where the content will land, the same carve as a field
shade under its top lip, so it reads as a recess and not as a grey block
lines of a text skeleton are as far apart as lines of body text
a text line is as tall as the body type it stands in for
the faintest point of its slow breath, still visible as a recess on bright scenes
one keycap height for every key, so a shortcut lines up inside a sentence
room either side of the key, so even a single character clears the cap’s edge by 8px
a small corner, the radius of the smallest marks
the keycap is lit at its top edge by the one light from above
and darker toward its foot, like every raised slab on a pane
a short soft shadow under the cap so it stands on the pane
before an image arrives its space is the carve of the glass, never a white box
an image that failed stays a recess, quiet, with its alt text available
an image fades in from this point as it loads, so it arrives rather than pops
a step bigger than an IconButton so the one main action is easy to hit with a thumb
the loud solid lit at its top, the same bead as a loud IconButton
and the loud solid toward its foot, so every overlay reads as one family
the glyph on the loud solid, ink in dark and white in light
in dark it shines with its own light, the one strong glow on the screen
floats 22px from the bottom end, at thumb reach and clear of the edge gestures
the gap between the title, the body and the actions of an overlay
an overlay always keeps 16px from the screen edge so it reads as a pane, not the page
an action row in an action sheet is a full 44px target
overlays blur what is under them like every pane, so they read as glass
the scrim dims the scene under a level-3 overlay so the overlay reads as above everything
the grabber is a quiet bar, visible but never the loudest thing on the sheet
a tooltip is the top of the stack, level 4, the same body as a popover
and the level-4 shadow, so it floats over everything
a toast floats at level 4 over whatever is on screen
with the level-4 shadow, the longest one, so every overlay reads as one family
dialogs and sheets sit above the page and its sticky header
popovers, tooltips and toasts sit above dialogs, the top of the stack
a floating action sits over the content but under every overlay
label and field sit close, the same gap as every field in Pane
the rows sit this far inside the sheet, and their corners nest the sheet’s by this much
the sheet has the inner corner; its rows nest it
every option row is a 44px target, easy to hit on a phone
the popup list is an opaque sheet so its options read on any scene
a quiet edge round the sheet so it stands off the page
the sheet floats over the page on the float shadow
the highlighted row is a lighter pane inside the sheet
lit on its top edge like a lens, the one light from above
fields and the on-page list are recesses carved into the glass
the field’s groove with its 3:1 edge, the same as Input
a field is at least 44px tall and grows as chips wrap
a field that may wrap to several lines takes the media corner, not a full pill
text and chips keep the field’s inset from its edge
the typing space never shrinks below a short word
a popup list stops at about seven rows
a menu is at least wide enough for a short label and a shortcut
cards wrap to a new row before they get narrower than their title
a radio card is a surface inside a pane, level 2
a card lightens a little under the pointer at hover pace
each card has the faint edge all round of every slab
the chosen card is chosen glass, lit at its top
and toward its foot, like a chosen tab
the chosen card lifts on the chosen cast, so it reads as picked up
the check mark is the loud solid, a shape that says chosen without a hue
the check on the loud solid, ink in dark and white in light
one star size for every rating, readable at a glance in a row
chosen stars are the loud solid, so the score reads without a gold hue
empty stars are an outline at the 3:1 edge opacity, still countable
segments and destinations sit close inside their track
the chosen pane sits this far inside the track, nesting its corner
a segmented control’s track is the same well as the tab track
shade under the track’s top lip, a recess
the chosen segment, destination or page is chosen glass lit at its top
and toward its foot, the same as a chosen tab
the chosen pane lifts a little on the chosen cast
no segment gets narrower than a short word
bars and docks are level-1 glass over the page
a floating dock carries the level-1 shadow, the same for every part of the family
the bottom dock floats clear of the screen edge and its gestures
bars blur the page under them like every pane
the top bar is tall enough for 44px targets
the faint edge all round of every slab
a destination is taller than 44px with its icon and label
a destination is at least 64px wide, the same for every part of the family
a sidebar is as wide as the book’s own, so labels fit on one line
a count on a destination is the badge size
a count is a small loud mark, the only solid in the dock
its number on the loud solid, the same for every part of the family
a navigation panel is one column of described links
a navigation panel is level 4, the top of the stack
with the level-4 shadow, the same for every part of the family
the section in view has a lit line beside it, a mark in the loud solid
steps are joined by a quiet groove, the same for every part of the family
the groove is lit up to the current step, at the edge opacity
the current step is the loud solid with its number
its number on the loud solid, the same for every part of the family
in dark the current step glows as a mark that says now (D-027)
